The structure of Cs4Mg2Re4O16 (reduced formula Cs2Mg(ReO4)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Re each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while Cs centers have 12 O neighbors. Re octahedra share edges with one another and corners with Mg octahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
